name: khana-khajana
description: 🍛 Modern single-page restaurant website with menu showcase, gallery, WhatsApp booking, and garden venue tour — pure HTML/CSS/JS

paragraphs: Khana Khajana is a modern, single-page restaurant website built for a premium family garden restaurant in Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan. The goal was simple: give every visitor an appetizing first impression the moment the page loads, and make it effortless for them to go from "this looks nice" to "table booked" — all without leaving a single page.

It's built to feel warm and inviting like the restaurant itself — a blend of indoor dining elegance and open garden charm — while staying fast and lightweight enough to load instantly on a visitor's mobile data.
features: The homepage opens with a curated photo collage that instantly sets the mood — food, ambience, and garden views in one glance. A dedicated full-gallery collage lets visitors browse a wider set of restaurant photography…

Two embedded videos — a garden tour and a restaurant reel — give visitors a real feel for the space before they arrive. Video does a better job than photos alone at conveying atmosphere, especially for the garden…

Rather than a plain text menu, dishes are presented as rich visual cards — thalis, curries, paneer specialties, naan combos, and more — so visitors can literally see what they're ordering. Desserts and drinks (lassi,…

Separate visuals for the indoor dining hall, main hall, and outdoor garden walkway/entrance help visitors picture exactly where they'll be seated — useful for anyone choosing between an indoor or garden-side table.
An embedded map makes the restaurant easy to find with a single tap, removing the friction of copy-pasting an address into a separate maps app.
